# @uptimizr/schema

> The single source of truth for every Uptimizr analytics event: Zod runtime schemas plus
> inferred TypeScript types. Import event shapes from here — never redefine them elsewhere.

## Docs

- [Package reference](./README.md): install, envelope, full event catalog, extension point.
- [Agent guide](./AGENTS.md): rules and canonical usage for AI agents.
- [Integration & API reference](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/blob/main/docs/integration.md): track, replay, and query the data.
- [Architecture Decision Records](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/tree/main/docs/adr): privacy model (0003) and the registry-based event design.

## Key exports

- `anyEventSchema` — discriminated union over all event `type`s.
- `collectRequestSchema` — the `/api/v1/collect` batch body.
- Per-event schemas and inferred types (e.g. `CameraSampleEvent`).
- Config / metadata contracts (deliberately **not** events): `sceneProxySchema` (registry geometry),
  `sceneRegionSchema` / `sceneRegionsSchema` (named scene regions), `funnelConfigSchema`,
  `queryV1Schema` (the analytics query DSL, ADR 0051 §3 — shape only; the metric/filter vocabulary
  is checked by `validateQuery()` in `@uptimizr/metrics`), and the project-metadata shapes
  `annotationSchema`, `glossaryEntrySchema`, `savedAnalysisSchema` with `metadataAuthorKindSchema`
  (ADR 0051 §5). The metadata ones bound the collector's `annotate`-gated write path; they never
  reach the ingest path, and events remain read-only.
- `subscriptionSchema` — a conditional subscription (ADR 0051 §6): a registry metric, a window,
  a closed predicate union (threshold | anomaly | movers | new_value | presence), a cooldown and
  delivery targets. Config, not an event. `parseDurationMs` parses its "5m"/"1h" literals.
- `panelSpecV1Schema` — a declarative dashboard panel (ADR 0051 §7): `{ v, title, query, chart,
  encoding?, span, note? }`, with `panelSpecQuerySchema` (`queryV1` minus `format`/`explain`, whose
  `range` may also be the literal `PANEL_RANGE_INHERIT`), `panelSpecRangeSchema`,
  `panelChartKindSchema` (stat | table | bar | line | area | heatmap2d | world3d),
  `panelEncodingSchema` (which result column feeds `x`/`y`/`series`) and
  `resolvePanelSpecRange(range, active)`. Shape only — `validatePanelSpec()` in `@uptimizr/metrics`
  decides whether the chart suits the metric's grain and whether the encoding names real columns.
  Config, not an event: a spec is data, rendered with panels `@uptimizr/react` already ships, so
  nothing is loaded and nothing is evaluated. Bounds: `LIMITS.maxPanelSpecTitleLength` (120),
  `maxPanelSpecNoteLength` (500), `maxPanelEncodingColumnLength` (64),
  `maxProjectPanelSpecs` (50). No serialized-length cap: every leaf is bounded here or by `queryV1`.
